# M3a Wikipedia extraction pilot (auto-generated by `python -m scout.text.wiki_run`)

Commit `096dee6`, model `claude-haiku-5-5`, prompt `extract-v3`, year rule `context-year`, batch `msgbatch_01NnjHfEaf5f2DjY96Q2iRux`. Text from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0); each example links to the exact diff it came from.

- Documents: 20 submitted, 20 succeeded
- Tokens: 26,517 in / 3,901 out (mean 1,326 / 195 per doc); cost **$0.00** (Batch API)
- Events returned: 33; kept after verification: **9**
- Dropped by reason: {'no_quote': 0, 'bad_date': 0, 'year_only': 3, 'outside_window': 21, 'date_not_in_text': 0, 'bad_type': 0}
- Kept by type: {'transfer': 6, 'injury': 1, 'loan': 1, 'contract_extension': 1}

**Full-run estimate:** ~21,852 non-empty documents (all labelled player-years with an English Wikipedia page × the non-empty share in this sample) × measured mean tokens = **$2.51** on the Batch API.

**Sample spread** (documents per snapshot year): 2014: 3, 2016: 3, 2017: 1, 2018: 3, 2019: 1, 2020: 2, 2021: 1, 2023: 3, 2024: 3

## Moves vs Transfermarkt transfers

- Scored on players with at least one recorded transfer; 4 extracted moves of players with none were left out (coverage gap in the table, not an extraction error)
- Precision: 3 of 3 extracted transfers/loans match a recorded move within 31 days = 100% (95% CI 44%–100%)
- Recall: 4 of 7 recorded senior moves in the windows were extracted = 57% (95% CI 25%–84%) (bounded: documents hold only text added during the year)
